signature_introspection: unavailable — native bindings raise ValueError under inspect.signature. Behaviour will be established by known-answer fixtures rather than by documented form.

footprint.method: UsdGeom.BBoxCache over default+render+proxy+guide purposes, union of prims carrying UsdPhysics.CollisionAPI
footprint.representation_justification: The platform footprint is approximately rectangular and PhysX provides oriented box overlap and sweep primitives directly. sweep_shape_* remains available if a box proves inadequate, but switching would be recorded, not silent.
footprint.note_default_purpose_returned_nothing: ComputeWorldBound with the default purpose alone returned empty ranges for every collider — inverted FLT_MAX sentinels that a careless reader would take as a valid huge box. Collision geometry here carries a non-default purpose, so the cache must span default+render+proxy+guide.

supersedes.consequence: The rejected AABB pose selection used ROBOT_RADIUS_M = 0.25, invented rather than read from the robot. The true circumscribed radius is 0.152 m, so every candidate was required to clear a footprint about 1.6x too large in radius — roughly 2.7x in area. That compounded with bounding-box over-occupancy to produce the 1.3% usable floor. Two independent inventions in one estimator, each individually plausible.

claim_boundary: Establishes the collision footprint of the CANONICAL_SIMULATION_ROBOT_COLLISION_MODEL under Isaac Sim 5.1.0.0. Not a measured physical Yahboom: wheel radius and related dimensions remain PROVISIONAL_SIMULATION_VALUE.
